en.t: Goguryeo-Sui War: In response to a Goguryeo (Korean) incursion into Liaoxi, Emperor Wéndi of Sui orders his youngest son, Yang Liang (assisted by the co-prime minister Gao Jiong), to conquer Goguryeo during the Manchurian rainy season, with a Chinese army and navy
en.s: The Goguryeo–Sui War were a series of invasions launched by the Sui dynasty of China against Goguryeo, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea, between AD 598 and AD 614. It resulted in the defeat of the Sui and was one of the pivotal factors in the collapse of the dynasty, which led to its overthrow by the Tang dynasty in AD 618.

zh.t: 高句丽—隋战争：高句丽（朝鲜）入侵辽西后，隋文帝命令幼子杨谅在高颎辅佐下率水陆大军，于满洲雨季征服高句丽
zh.s: 高句丽—隋战争是公元598年至614年间隋朝对朝鲜三国之一高句丽发动的一系列入侵。战争以隋朝战败告终，也是隋朝崩溃的重要因素之一；隋朝最终于公元618年被唐朝推翻。

en.s: The Battle of al-Funt (Friday 4 August 1038) was a battle that took place near modern-day Deifontes between the forces of the Taifa of Granada ruled by Badis ibn Habus against the forces of the Taifa of Almería led by Zuhayr al-Siqlabi, it ended with a Granadan Zirid victory and the death of Zuhayr, marking an end to the hegemony of the Amirids in Eastern Andalucia.

zh.s: 芬特战役于1038年8月4日星期五发生在今迪丰特斯附近。交战双方是由巴迪斯·伊本·哈布斯统治的格拉纳达泰法王国军队，以及祖海尔·西克拉比率领的阿尔梅里亚泰法王国军队。战斗以格拉纳达齐里德王朝获胜、祖海尔阵亡告终，也标志着阿米里德王朝对安达卢斯东部的霸权结束。

en.s: The Battle of Evesham (4 August 1265) was one of the two main battles of 13th century England's Second Barons' War. It marked the defeat of Simon de Montfort, Earl of Leicester, and the rebellious barons by Prince Edward – later King Edward I – who led the forces of his father, King Henry III. It took place on 4 August 1265, near the town of Evesham, Worcestershire. With the Battle of Lewes Montfort had won control of royal government, but after the defection of several close allies and the escape from captivity of Prince Edward, he found himself on the defensive.

zh.s: 伊夫舍姆战役于1265年8月4日发生，是13世纪英格兰第二次男爵战争中的两场主要战役之一。此役中，莱斯特伯爵西蒙·德·蒙福尔和叛乱男爵被爱德华王子击败。爱德华后来成为爱德华一世，他当时率领父亲亨利三世国王的军队。战役发生在伍斯特郡伊夫舍姆镇附近。此前，蒙福尔在刘易斯战役后控制了王室政府；但几名亲密盟友倒戈，爱德华王子逃出囚禁后，蒙福尔转入守势。

en.s: The Battle of Tachov (German: Schlacht bei Tachau) or Battle of Mies (German: Schlacht bei Mies) was a battle fought on 4 August 1427 near the Bohemian towns of Tachov (Tachau) and Stříbro (Mies). The Hussites won over the armies led by the Cardinal Henry Beaufort of England and Archbishop of Trier Otto von Ziegenhain. It was part of the Hussite Wars, and it was the first battle in which war wagons were used by the crusaders. The battle showed that the Wagenburg could not be used successfully by just any army. It took an army that knew how to use the wagons to make them successful.

zh.s: 塔霍夫战役（德语：Schlacht bei Tachau），又称米斯战役（德语：Schlacht bei Mies），于1427年8月4日在波希米亚的塔霍夫（德语名塔豪）和斯特日布罗（德语名米斯）两镇附近发生。胡斯派击败了由英格兰红衣主教亨利·博福特和特里尔大主教奥托·冯·齐根海因率领的军队。这是胡斯战争的一部分，也是十字军首次使用战车的战役。此役表明，战车堡垒战术并非任何军队都能成功运用；只有熟练掌握战车的军队才能发挥其作用。

en.s: The Battle of Győr was fought between the Ottomans and the Habsburgs on August 4, 1577, during a truce period. The Ottomans defeated the Habsburgs.

zh.s: 1577年8月4日，奥斯曼帝国与哈布斯堡王朝在停战期间发生杰尔战役。奥斯曼军队击败了哈布斯堡军队。

en.s: The Battle of Ksar El Kebir, also known as Battle of Three Kings (in Arabic: معركة الملوك الثلاث) or Battle of Oued al-Makhazin (in Arabic: معركة وادي المخازن) in Morocco, and Batalha de Alcácer Quibir in Portugal (variant spellings are legion: Alcácer-Quivir, Alcazarquivir, Alcassar, meaning grand castle in Arabic), (Battle of Alcazar in English) was fought in northern Morocco, near the town of Ksar-el-Kebir and Larache, on 4 August 1578. The combatants were the army of the deposed Moroccan Sultan Abu Abdallah Mohammed II, with his ally, the King of Portugal Sebastian I, and a large Moroccan army nominally under the new Sultan of Morocco (and uncle of Abu Abdallah Mohammed II) Abd Al-Malik I.

zh.t: 阿尔卡萨尔基维尔战役（盖斯尔·凯比尔战役）
zh.s: 这场战役在摩洛哥称为盖斯尔·凯比尔战役，也称“三王之战”（阿拉伯语：معركة الملوك الثلاث）或“瓦迪·马赫津河战役”（阿拉伯语：معركة وادي المخازن）；葡萄牙语称Batalha de Alcácer Quibir（另有多种拼写），英语称“阿尔卡萨尔战役”。战役于1578年8月4日在摩洛哥北部、盖斯尔·凯比尔镇和拉拉什附近发生。参战一方是被废黜的摩洛哥苏丹阿布·阿卜杜拉·穆罕默德二世及其盟友葡萄牙国王塞巴斯蒂昂一世；另一方是名义上由新任摩洛哥苏丹阿卜杜勒·马利克一世统率的大军。阿卜杜勒·马利克一世是阿布·阿卜杜拉·穆罕默德二世的叔叔。

en.s: The siege of Sluis of 1587 took place between 12 June and 4 August 1587, as part of the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). Its capture by the Spanish formed a significant advance towards the Enterprise of England.

zh.s: 斯勒伊斯围城战于1587年6月12日至8月4日进行，是八十年战争和英西战争（1585—1604年）的一部分。西班牙军队攻占该城，为其入侵英格兰的计划取得重要进展。

en.s: The Raid on Mounts Bay also known as the Spanish attack on Mounts Bay was a Spanish raid on Cornwall, England, that took place between 2 and 4 August 1595 in the context of the Brittany Campaign during the Anglo-Spanish war of 1585-1604. It was conducted by a Spanish naval squadron led by Carlos de Amésquita on patrol from Brittany, France.

zh.s: 芒特斯湾突袭也称西班牙袭击芒特斯湾，是1595年8月2日至4日发生在英格兰康沃尔的一次西班牙突袭，属于1585—1604年英西战争期间布列塔尼战役的一部分。西班牙海军分舰队从法国布列塔尼出发巡逻，由卡洛斯·德·阿梅斯基塔率领。

en.s: The raid on La Goulette of 1609 was a naval attack by Spanish captain Luis Fajardo, at the head of a Spanish fleet and a French ship, on La Goulette, the main port of Ottoman Tunisia. The attack was carried on in response to previous acts of Barbary pirates based off Tunis, who now planned to raid the Spanish treasure fleet.

zh.s: 1609年，西班牙海军上将路易斯·法哈多率领西班牙舰队和一艘法国船只，袭击奥斯曼突尼斯的主要港口拉古莱特。此次行动是对突尼斯附近巴巴里海盗此前行动的回应；海盗当时正计划袭击西班牙宝船队。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Palos was a naval engagement between the Spanish and Algerian fleets off Cape Palos in 1617. The Spanish fleet was sailing to Naples but was intercepted by the Algerian fleet. The battle ended disastrously for the Spanish, who suffered heavy losses.

zh.s: 1617年，西班牙舰队与阿尔及尔舰队在帕洛斯角附近交战。西班牙舰队原本正驶往那不勒斯，途中遭阿尔及尔舰队拦截。西班牙损失惨重，战斗以惨败告终。

en.s: The Siege of Stralsund, 13 May to 4 August 1628, took place during the Thirty Years' War when an Imperial Army under Albrecht von Wallenstein attempted to capture the key Baltic Sea port of Stralsund. Then an independent city and part of the Hanseatic League, Stralsund was initially reinforced by small numbers of Scots mercenaries in Danish service, before Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden sent a larger force under Alexander Leslie.
en.n: The Siege of Stralsund, 13 May to 4 August 1628, took place during the Thirty Years' War when an Imperial Army under Albrecht von Wallenstein attempted to capture the key Baltic Sea port of Stralsund.

zh.s: 施特拉尔松德围城战于1628年5月13日至8月4日进行，是三十年战争的一部分。阿尔布雷希特·冯·瓦伦斯坦率领帝国军队试图攻占这一重要波罗的海港口。施特拉尔松德当时是一座独立城市，也是汉萨同盟成员。起初，丹麦派驻的少量苏格兰雇佣兵增援了城市；随后，瑞典国王古斯塔夫·阿道夫派亚历山大·莱斯利率领更多兵力前来。
zh.n: 施特拉尔松德围城战于1628年5月13日至8月4日进行，是三十年战争的一部分。

en.s: The battle of Marshall's Elm was a skirmish that took place near Street, in the county of Somerset, South West England, on 4 August 1642. The engagement occurred during the build-up to formal beginning of the First English Civil War on 22 August, while the Royalists and Parliamentarians were recruiting men in the county. The Royalists had established their regional headquarters in Wells, but were threatened by superior Parliamentarian numbers in the vicinity.

zh.s: 马歇尔榆树战斗于1642年8月4日在英格兰西南部萨默塞特郡斯特里特附近发生，是一次小规模交战。第一次英格兰内战于8月22日正式爆发，此前，保王党和议会派正在该郡招募兵员。保王党已将区域总部设在韦尔斯，但附近议会派兵力占优，对其构成威胁。

en.s: The siege of Bar took place on 4 August 1648 between the Zaporozhian Cossacks and the Polish–Lithuanian garrison of the Bar fortress, during the Khmelnytsky Uprising. Cossack colonel Maksym Kryvonis laid siege to the fortress and captured it along with its garrison.

zh.s: 1648年8月4日，扎波罗热哥萨克与波兰—立陶宛守军在赫梅利尼茨基起义期间围攻巴尔要塞。哥萨克上校马克西姆·克里沃尼斯率军围城，并攻占要塞及其驻军。

en.s: During the Khmelnytsky Uprising, on 4 August 1651 Kyiv was captured by Lithuanian forces under the command of Janusz Radziwiłł.

zh.s: 赫梅利尼茨基起义期间，扬努什·拉齐维乌率领的立陶宛军队于1651年8月4日攻占基辅。

en.s: The Landing at Humlebæk took place on August 4, 1700 (Gregorian calendar), in the Swedish invasion of Denmark during the Great Northern War 1700-1721. This was the first offensive during the war by the Swedish army, and it was directly led by Charles XII of Sweden commanding the right flank and Arvid Horn together with Carl Gustav Rehnskiöld at the left.

zh.s: 胡姆勒贝克登陆战于1700年8月4日（公历）发生，是大北方战争（1700—1721年）期间瑞典入侵丹麦的一部分。这是战争中瑞典军队的首次进攻，由瑞典国王卡尔十二世直接指挥右翼，阿尔维德·霍恩和卡尔·古斯塔夫·雷恩舍尔德指挥左翼。

en.s: The Great Peace of Montreal (French: La Grande paix de Montréal) was a peace treaty between New France and 39 First Nations of North America that ended the Beaver Wars. It was signed on August 4, 1701, by Louis-Hector de Callière, governor of New France, and 1300 representatives of 39 Indigenous nations.

zh.s: 《蒙特利尔大和平》（法语：La Grande paix de Montréal）是新法兰西与北美39个原住民族之间的一项和平条约，结束了海狸战争。条约于1701年8月4日签署，由新法兰西总督路易-埃克托·德·卡利埃和39个原住民族的1,300名代表签署。

en.s: The Beaver Wars (Mohawk: Tsianì kayonkwere, pronounced [d͡ʒanî gajũgwere]), also known as the Iroquois Wars or the French and Iroquois Wars (French: Guerres franco-iroquoises), were a series of conflicts fought intermittently during the 17th century in North America throughout the Great Lakes region and the St. Lawrence River valley which pitted the Haudenosaunee (Iroquois) – who were supported by the Dutch and later the English – against neighbouring Indigenous nations such as the Wendat (Huron), who were supported by the French.

zh.s: 海狸战争（莫霍克语：Tsianì kayonkwere，读作[d͡ʒanî gajũgwere]）也称易洛魁战争或法易战争（法语：Guerres franco-iroquoises），是17世纪北美大湖地区和圣劳伦斯河谷间歇发生的一系列冲突。参战双方为得到荷兰、后来又得到英国支持的豪德诺索尼人（易洛魁人），以及得到法国支持的邻近原住民族，例如温达特人（休伦人）。

en.s: The capture of Gibraltar by Anglo-Dutch forces of the Grand Alliance occurred between 1 and 4 August 1704 during the War of the Spanish Succession. (see All dates in the annotations) Since the beginning of the war the Alliance had been looking for a harbour in the Iberian Peninsula to control the Strait of Gibraltar and facilitate naval operations against the French fleet in the western Mediterranean Sea.

zh.s: 西班牙王位继承战争期间，大同盟的英荷联军于1704年8月1日至4日攻占直布罗陀。（所有日期请见注释。）战争爆发后，大同盟一直在伊比利亚半岛寻找港口，以控制直布罗陀海峡，并便于对西地中海的法国舰队开展海上行动。

en.s: The Battle of Banja Luka (Turkish: Banaluka Savaşı, Bosnian: Banjalučki boj) was a battle in which the Ottoman Empire, led by Hekimoğlu Ali Pasha, defeated the Holy Roman Empire. It took place on 4 August 1737 near the Bosnian town of Banja Luka. The Bosnian population was aware that the Austrian forces would invade Bosnia during the war. That's why Hekimoğlu Ali Pasha called a meeting in Travnik with the Bosnian captains to plan the defense. The Ottoman forces where planning the defense without the help of Istanbul..

zh.s: 巴尼亚卢卡战役中，赫基莫奥卢·阿里帕夏率领的奥斯曼帝国击败了神圣罗马帝国。战役于1737年8月4日在波斯尼亚的巴尼亚卢卡附近发生。波斯尼亚民众得知奥地利军队将在战争期间入侵波斯尼亚，因此赫基莫奥卢·阿里帕夏召集波斯尼亚各地的队长在特拉夫尼克开会，筹划防御。奥斯曼军队计划在没有伊斯坦布尔支援的情况下组织防御。

en.s: Bird's invasion of Kentucky in 1780 was one of four concurrent military operations organized by the British in the Trans-Appalachia region during the Revolutionary War. The goal was to clear the Illinois Country and the Mississippi River valley of Spanish and American forces. While Bird's campaign met with limited success, destroying two fortified settlements in Kentucky County and taking several hundred prisoners, it failed its primary objective of destroying the American fort at the Falls of the Ohio.

zh.s: 1780年，伯德入侵肯塔基是英国在独立战争期间于阿巴拉契亚山脉以西地区同时展开的四次军事行动之一。行动目标是驱逐驻守伊利诺伊地区和密西西比河谷的西班牙与美国势力。伯德的部队摧毁了肯塔基县两处设防居民点并俘虏数百人，但未能攻占俄亥俄瀑布附近的美国要塞，主要目标未能实现。

en.s: The Treaty of Sistova ended the last Austro-Turkish war (1787–91). Brokered by Great Britain, Prussia and the Netherlands, it was signed in Sistova (modern Svishtov) in Bulgaria on 4 August 1791. The treaty was written in French and Turkish.

zh.s: 锡斯托瓦条约结束了最后一场奥土战争（1787—1791年）。该条约由英国、普鲁士和荷兰斡旋，于1791年8月4日在保加利亚锡斯托瓦（今斯维什托夫）签署。条约以法语和土耳其语写成。

en.s: The Austro-Turkish War, also known as the Habsburg–Ottoman War, was fought from 1788 to 1791, between the Habsburg monarchy and the Ottoman Empire. During the conflict, Habsburg armies succeeded in taking Belgrade (1789) and liberating much of central Serbia, also capturing several forts in central Croatia and in the Pounje region of Ottoman Bosnia.

zh.s: 奥土战争也称哈布斯堡—奥斯曼战争，于1788年至1791年间在哈布斯堡君主国与奥斯曼帝国之间进行。战争期间，哈布斯堡军队成功夺取贝尔格莱德（1789年），解放塞尔维亚中部大片地区，还占领了克罗地亚中部和奥斯曼统治下波斯尼亚的波乌涅地区数座堡垒。

en.s: The Battle of Lonato was fought on 3 and 4 August 1796 between the French Army of Italy under General Napoleon Bonaparte and a corps-sized Austrian column led by Lieutenant General Peter Quasdanovich. A week of hard-fought actions that began on 29 July and ended on 4 August resulted in the retreat of Quasdanovich's badly mauled force. The elimination of Quasdanovich's threat allowed Bonaparte to concentrate against and defeat the main Austrian army at the Battle of Castiglione on 5 August. Lonato del Garda is located near the SP 668 highway and the Brescia-Padua section of Autostrada A4 to the southwest of Lake Garda.

zh.s: 洛纳托战役于1796年8月3日至4日进行，交战双方是拿破仑·波拿巴将军率领的法国意大利军团，以及彼得·夸斯达诺维奇中将率领的一支奥地利军团级部队。从7月29日至8月4日，双方连续一周激战，夸斯达诺维奇的部队遭受重创后撤退。消除这支部队的威胁后，波拿巴得以集中兵力，在8月5日的卡斯蒂廖内战役中击败奥地利主力。加尔达湖西南方的洛纳托·德尔·加尔达位于SP 668公路和A4高速公路布雷西亚—帕多瓦路段附近。

en.s: The 1797 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held between August 3 and 4, 1797 in order to elect the Governor of Tennessee. Democratic-Republican nominee and incumbent Governor John Sevier ran unopposed and thus won re-election, but the exact election results are unknown.

zh.s: 1797年田纳西州州长选举于1797年8月3日至4日举行。民主共和党候选人、现任州长约翰·塞维尔没有对手，当选连任；具体选举结果不详。

en.s: The action of 4 August 1800 took place off the Brazilian coast during the War of the Second Coalition. A French Navy squadron of three frigates under Commodore Jean-François Landolphe which had been raiding British commerce off West Africa approached and attempted to attack a British merchant convoy. The convoy was escorted by the Royal Navy ship of the line HMS Belliqueux.

en.s: The Greek raid on Alexandria was an unsuccessful attempt organized by Greek admiral Konstantinos Kanaris to destroy the Egyptian fleet at its base in Alexandria in 1825 during the Greek War of Independence. In February 1825, an Egyptian army under the command of Ibrahim Pasha had landed in the Morea, and inflicted a series of defeats on the Greeks. Kanaris decided if he could destroy the Egyptian fleet, he would cut off Ibrahim Pasha from being supplied from Egypt. On August 4, 1825, a Greek force consisting of two warships and three fire ships sailed from Hydra, under the overall command of Emmanouil Tombazis on the corvette Themistocles, the other ships being the brig of Kriezis, two Hydriot fireships (under Antonios Vokos and Manolis Boutis) and Kanaris' own Psarian fire ship.

en.s: The Great Spokane Fire—known locally as The Great Fire—was a major fire which affected downtown Spokane, Washington (called "Spokane Falls" at the time) on August 4, 1889. en.s: The German invasion of Belgium began on 4 August 1914 during the first World War. On 24 July, the Belgian government had announced that if war came it would uphold its neutrality. The Belgian government mobilised its armed forces on 31 July and a state of heightened alert (Kriegsgefahr) was proclaimed in Germany. On 2 August, the German government sent an ultimatum to Belgium, demanding passage through the country and German forces invaded Luxembourg. Two days later, the Belgian government refused the German demands and the British government guaranteed military support to Belgium.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，德国于1914年8月4日开始入侵比利时。7月24日，比利时政府宣布，如果战争爆发，将维持中立。比利时政府于7月31日动员武装部队，德国则宣布进入高度戒备状态（Kriegsgefahr）。8月2日，德国政府向比利时发出最后通牒，要求德军借道比利时；当天德国军队也入侵了卢森堡。两天后，比利时政府拒绝德国要求，英国政府保证向比利时提供军事支持。

en.s: The Gorlice–Tarnów offensive during World War I was initially conceived as a minor German offensive to relieve Russian pressure on the Austro-Hungarians to their south on the Eastern Front, but resulted in the Central Powers' chief offensive effort of 1915, causing the total collapse of the Russian lines and their retreat far into Russia.
en.n: World War I: The German 12th Army occupies Warsaw during the Gorlice–Tarnów Offensive and the Great Retreat of 1915.

en.s: Enver Pasha's Rebellion (Uzbek: Enver poshoning qo'zg'oloni) refers to an armed uprising that was a part of the much larger Basmachi Revolt. It was conducted by the former Ottoman Minister of War, Enver Pasha. The uprising started in the summer of 1921 when Enver Pasha arrived in Bukhara to negotiate with the Basmachi. He ended up defecting to the Basmachi and began fighting the Bolsheviks.

en.s: Operation Hurry (31 July – 4 August 1940) was the first British operation in a series that have come to be known as Club Runs. The goal of the operation was to fly twelve Hurricane Mk I fighters from HMS Argus to Malta, guided by two Skuas of the Fleet Air Arm. Force H, based in Gibraltar, took the opportunity to raid Elmas airfield in Sardinia and conduct a deception operation with HMS Enterprise.

en.s: The Norilsk uprising was a major strike by Gulag inmates in Gorlag, an MVD special camp for political prisoners, and later in the two camps of Norillag [ITL], Norilsk, USSR, now Russia, in the summer of 1953, shortly after Joseph Stalin's death. en.s: The New Democratic Party's founding convention was held in Ottawa from July 31 to August 4, 1961. This convention formally closed down the Co-operative Commonwealth Federation (CCF) party and the New Party clubs, and merged them with the Canadian Labour Congress (CLC) to form the NDP. It is also known for the divisive leadership vote in which Saskatchewan Premier Tommy Douglas was elected over national CCF leader Hazen Argue.

en.s: Ariane 3 (French: [aʁjan tʁwɑ]) was a European expendable carrier rocket, which was used for eleven launches between 1984 and 1989. It was a member of the Ariane family of rockets. The principal manufacturer for the Ariane 3 was Aérospatiale, while the lead agency for its development was the Centre National d'Études Spatiales (CNES). en.s: Operation Storm (Serbo-Croatian: Operacija Oluja / Операција Олуја) in August 1995 was the last major battle of the Croatian War of Independence and a major factor in the outcome of the Bosnian War. It was a decisive victory for the Croatian Army (HV), which attacked across a 630-kilometre (390 mi) front against the self-declared proto-state Republic of Serbian Krajina (RSK), and a strategic victory for the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ARBiH). The HV was supported by the Croatian special police advancing from the Velebit Mountain, and the ARBiH located in the Bihać pocket, in the Army of the Republic of Serbian Krajina's (ARSK) rear. The battle, launched to restore Croatian control of 10,400 square kilometres (4,000 square miles) of territory – representing 18.4% of the territory it claimed – and Bosniak control of Western Bosnia, was the largest land battle that took place in Europe between the end of World War II and the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Operation Storm commenced at dawn on 4 August 1995 and was declared complete on the evening of 7 August, despite significant mopping-up operations against pockets of resistance lasting until 14 August.

zh.s: 风暴行动（塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语：Operacija Oluja / Операција Олуја）发生于1995年8月，是克罗地亚独立战争的最后一场重大战役，也是影响波斯尼亚战争结果的重要因素。克罗地亚军队在长达630公里（390英里）的战线上进攻自称成立的塞尔维亚克拉伊纳共和国（RSK），取得决定性胜利；波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那共和国军也取得战略胜利。克罗地亚特种警察从韦莱比特山推进，为克罗地亚军队提供支援；波黑共和国军则部署在比哈奇口袋地区，位于塞尔维亚克拉伊纳共和国军后方。此次行动旨在恢复克罗地亚对10,400平方公里（4,000平方英里）领土的控制；该面积占克罗地亚所主张领土的18.4%。行动还旨在恢复波斯尼亚人对波斯尼亚西部的控制。这是第二次世界大战结束至2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间欧洲规模最大的陆战。风暴行动于1995年8月4日黎明开始，并于8月7日晚宣布结束，尽管清剿零星抵抗力量的行动持续到8月14日。

en.s: The Muttur Massacre was an incident that occurred on 4 August 2006 in Muttur, Sri Lanka, in the district of Trincomalee, during the Sri Lankan civil war. Seventeen local employees of the French non-governmental organization Action Against Hunger were executed at close range inside their office. The victims were all local workers: sixteen of Sri Lankan Tamil ethnicity – including four women – and one Sri Lankan Moor, aged between 23 and 36. The massacre is considered one of the most serious ever committed against humanitarian workers in the history of NGOs. Years later, no one has ever been prosecuted or convicted for this crime.

en.s: On 4 August 2020, a major explosion occurred in Beirut, Lebanon, caused by the ignition of 2,750 tonnes of ammonium nitrate. The chemical, confiscated in 2014 from the cargo ship MV Rhosus and stored at the Port of Beirut without adequate safety measures for six years, detonated after a fire broke out in a nearby warehouse. The explosion resulted in at least 218 deaths, 7,000 injuries, and approximately 300,000 displaced people, alongside property damage estimated at US$15 billion. The blast released energy comparable to 1.1 kilotons of TNT, ranking it among the most powerful non-nuclear explosions ever recorded and the largest single detonation of ammonium nitrate.

en.s: An election was held on August 4, 2022, to determine the mayor of Knox County, Tennessee. The election was held concurrently with primary elections for various state offices, including the gubernatorial primaries. Incumbent Republican mayor Glenn Jacobs won re-election with 55.3% of the vote, defeating Democratic nominee Debbie Helsley. As mayor, Jacobs branded himself as a libertarian and opposed COVID-19 restrictions like mask mandates.

zh.t: 2022年田纳西州诺克斯县市长选举
zh.s: 田纳西州诺克斯县于2022年8月4日举行市长选举。选举与州内多个职位的初选同时举行，包括州长初选。共和党现任市长格伦·雅各布斯以55.3%的得票率击败民主党候选人黛比·赫尔斯利，当选连任。雅各布斯自称自由意志主义者，并反对口罩令等新冠防疫限制措施。

en.s: The 2022 Hamilton County mayoral election was held on August 4, 2022, to determine the next mayor of Hamilton County, Tennessee. Republican nominee Weston Wamp, son of former U.S. Representative Zach Wamp, won with 57.9% of the vote, defeating Democratic nominee Matt Adams. Incumbent Republican Mayor Jim Coppinger, who was appointed county mayor in 2011, chose not to run for a fourth term.

zh.t: 2022年田纳西州汉密尔顿县市长选举
zh.s: 田纳西州汉密尔顿县于2022年8月4日举行市长选举。共和党候选人韦斯顿·万普以57.9%的得票率击败民主党候选人马特·亚当斯，当选县长。韦斯顿是前美国众议员扎克·万普之子。共和党现任县长吉姆·科平杰于2011年获任命，他决定不竞选第四个任期。

en.s: The 2023 Johan Cruyff Shield was the 27th edition of the Johan Cruyff Shield (Dutch: Johan Cruijff Schaal), an annual Dutch football match played between the winners of the previous season's Eredivisie and KNVB Cup. The match was contested between Feyenoord, the winners of the 2022–23 Eredivisie, and PSV Eindhoven, the winners of the 2022–23 KNVB Cup.

en.s: The 2024 Major League Rugby Championship Final was the sixth Major League Rugby (MLR) championship match, held at the conclusion of the seventh season of the rugby union club competition in North America. The match was played on August 4, 2024, at Snapdragon Stadium in San Diego, California. It was contested by the Seattle Seawolves and New England Free Jacks.

en.s: The 2024 Johan Cruyff Shield was the 28th edition of the Johan Cruyff Shield (Dutch: Johan Cruijff Schaal), an annual Dutch association football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Eredivisie and KNVB Cup. It was played at the Philips Stadion in Eindhoven on 4 August 2024, and featured the 2023–24 Eredivisie champions PSV Eindhoven and the 2023–24 KNVB Cup winners Feyenoord.

en.s: The 2024 Piala Presiden final was the final match of the 2024 Piala Presiden, the 6th season of Indonesia's pre-season premier club football tournament organised by PSSI. It was played at the Manahan Stadium, in Surakarta, Indonesia on 4 August 2024. The final was played by Borneo Samarinda against the defending champions Arema. This match was a repeat of the previous final, which was won by Arema with an aggregate score of 1–0.

zh.s: 2024年总统杯决赛是印尼足协主办的季前俱乐部足球赛事“总统杯”第6届比赛的决赛。比赛于2024年8月4日在印度尼西亚苏拉卡尔塔的马纳汉体育场举行，由婆罗洲三马林达对阵卫冕冠军阿雷马。这是两队连续第二年在决赛相遇；上届决赛阿雷马以总比分1比0获胜。

en.t: 2024 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final
en.s: The 2024 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final was the 51st All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 2024 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship, an inter-county ladies' Gaelic football tournament for the county teams of Ireland. Kerry defeated Galway to win their 12th All-Ireland ladies title.
